Cause / trigger: Shipper absent or parcel not ready
Resolution and BPMN construct: Error/escalation boundary; reschedule up to 2 attempts, then cancel and apply fee
Correct at booking; at delivery contact recipient and use exclusive gateway for surcharge
Inspect; exclusive gateway checks insurance; claims sub-process or notify shipper
Timer starts tracing; if not found within 5 days declare lost, compensate, notify customer
Event-based gateway waits for delay message or timer; notify, reroute, update ETA
Request documents and wait up to 5 days; otherwise return to origin

Cause / trigger: No one present at delivery address
Resolution and BPMN construct: Retry up to 3 attempts; depot hold 7 days; then return to sender

Cause / trigger: Recipient refuses or COD payment fails
Resolution and BPMN construct: Exclusive delivery-outcome gateway; return to sender and adjust charges
Error boundary event; manual record update and reconciliation
Message boundary event; stop movement, return parcel, compensate/refund less fee
